title: Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade: Go Behind the Scenes with TODAY Show Radio
summary: The TODAY Show is broadcasting live with BTS from the Macy's Thanksgiving Parade on 34th Street, listen live on SiriusXM.
body_markdown:
**Schedule Update:** The 100th Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade has been postponed from Thursday, November 26 to Saturday, November 28 at 8:30am ET due to expected severe weather in New York City.


[TODAY Show Radio The TODAY Show on the go Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogMacysThanksgivingDayParadeTodayRadio)


[TODAY Show Radio](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/today-show-radio) takes you behind the scenes of the historic 100th Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade.


Listen as we chat with Savannah Guthrie, Hoda Kotb, and Al Roker live along the parade route. For an up-close look at the floats, balloons, and performances, follow[@todayonsiriusxm](https://www.instagram.com/todayonsiriusxm/) on Instagram.


Tune in to TODAY Show Radio (Ch. 110) and the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogMacysThanksgivingDayParadeTodayRadio) . SiriusXM broadcast timing will be updated once confirmed.


In honor of the parade’s centennial, several beloved balloons are set to return, including Bugs Bunny, Curious George, and the Blue Hippopotamus, making its comeback after 95 years. Teddy Swims, Jimmy Fallon & The Roots, Mckenna Grace, and more stars are among the announced performers and participants. And, of course, Santa Claus is expected to make an appearance.
